name: London Sweep Continuation
hypothesis: Asian-range sweeps in London continue in the sweep direction (pre-registered inverse of Kimi London Sweep Reversal).
risk_model: One planned risk unit; Stop beyond sweep candle opposite extreme +0.15 ATR; 2.5R; time limit 16:00 UTC or next data gap.
known_limitations: No verified edge. Pre-registered (commit 674ab1e) single-pass evaluation; all historical splits previously exposed. Correlated instruments.
